training_draws: Unchanged build_training_schedule, manifest order, one exposure per exam per epoch; identical draws and caches across the three methods within each seed.
initialization: Every shared shape-matched parameter copied from the same-seed candidate initialization. Only the binary versus ternary auxiliary classifier differs in shape.
numerics: Float32, no AMP, unchanged classifier/head architecture and loss; vision chunks at most 12 images and batched head updates of six parents with the existing per-parent normalized loss.
tune_cells: Existing 17 full-view cells: clean and 16 single-view noise/blur mild/moderate cells, existing stress seed 4242 and exact per-record realizations.
screening_selection: Minimum equally weighted mean AURC of the 16 stressed tune cells across all 20 checkpoints; earliest epoch breaks a tie. Also report fixed epoch 20 and every epoch's metrics. Clean AURC is reported separately.
selection_limitation: This development selection is not the full protocol selector: the mandatory same-seed clean MV-ACN reference and full baseline suite are not fitted in this screen. No production selection or pilot eligibility is claimed.
promising_signal: A candidate reduction of at least 5% in balanced tune AURC versus both learned controls and MSP in at least two seeds, with clean AURC no more than 0.005 above MSP in at least two seeds and a directionally consistent fixed-epoch comparison, would justify completing the mandatory controls. This is a development heuristic, not a statistical publication criterion.
no_rescue_search: No stronger corruptions, class reweighting, parameter tuning, seed selection, additional epochs, or outcome-driven method changes. Mixed or negative evidence is reported and requires a separate research decision.
private_outputs: Prepared input/target caches, schedules, row-level predictions, epoch/resume checkpoints and identity bindings remain outside Git. Only aggregate metrics and artifact hashes enter evidence.
